**Where it opens**
- The Inventory button in `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html:9` calls `openInventory()`.
- `openInventory()` is at `game-console.component.ts:237`. It calls `this.dialog.open(InventoryComponent, …)`.
- The dialog options are `panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel'` and `maxHeight: '90vh'`.

**Data passed**
- `data` is an `InventoryDialogData`, defined in `inventory.component.ts:19`. It has two fields: `characterId` (`this.characterId`) and `sessionId` (`this.sessionId`).
- `InventoryComponent` injects it with `MAT_DIALOG_DATA` as `this.data`.
- It only uses `this.data.characterId`. `sessionId` is passed but never used in the code I read.
- It also reads the `character` signal from `CharacterStateService`.

**API calls**
All of these go through `GameApiService` (`game-api.service.ts`):

| Component method | Service method | HTTP request |
|---|---|---|
| `loadInventory()` on `ngOnInit` | `getInventory(characterId)` | `GET /api/character/:id`, then maps the response to `{ inventory }` |
| `toggleEquip()` | `equipItem(characterId, itemId, equipped)` | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` with body `{ itemId, equipped }` |
| `dropItem()` (asks `confirm()` first) | `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` |
| `usePotion()` | `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (same call as dropping) |

- `usePotion()` rolls the heal dice on the client from `effect.heal`. It computes `newHp` capped at `max_hp`, and it only updates HP locally through `charSvc.setCharacter`. No API call persists the HP change. The server only sees the item deleted.
- This differs from `resolveCombat(..., 'use_item', itemId)`, which is a separate combat endpoint, `POST /api/combat/resolve`. The inventory dialog doesn't call it.
- After each successful call, the dialog updates its own `inventory` signal and `CharacterStateService.setInventory(res.inventory)`.
